## Release checks

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`

## Main branch recommendation

Keep `main` protected: require pull requests and require the **Quality gate**
and **Dependency review** status checks before merging. Repository settings are
intentionally not changed by this project automation.
